fix_proposal: Add a preflight check that verifies at least N sessions are discoverable for the 24h window and, if not, automatically broadens retrieval or flags telemetry gaps before scoring quality.
Add a fallback audit path that scans all sessions touched in the last 24h (not only currently active) before declaring limited findings.
Add a mandatory preflight check that broadens session sampling beyond active chats (e.g., include recent transcripts by updatedAt window) and explicitly reports sample size before scoring.
Increase audit window fallback (e.g., last 7d when <3 sessions in 24h) to ensure actionable daily insights.
Add a daily session-capture guardrail that verifies non-empty 24h session coverage and asks for scope expansion when only the current cron session is visible.
Add a mandatory 'coverage check' step that reports session count and explicitly widens retrieval (by kind/channel/active window) when fewer than expected sessions are found.
Require minimum sample threshold (e.g., >=3 substantive sessions) and automatically widen lookback to 72h when 24h data is sparse.
Add a minimum-sample guardrail: if fewer than 3 sessions in 24h, extend window to 72h or mark audit as low-confidence.
Broaden daily audit retrieval by including session kinds explicitly and sampling at least 10 recent messages per session when available.
Enforce a minimum evidence guardrail for daily audits: if fewer than 3 substantive sessions are found in 24h, auto-expand lookback (72h) and label confidence as low until coverage is met.
Add a fallback audit path that scans transcript files modified in the last 24h when sessions_list returns only the current session, then sample at least 5 sessions before scoring.
Add a minimum-sample gate: if fewer than 3 substantive sessions in 24h, emit 'NO_REPLY' plus a flagged log note to avoid over-interpreting sparse data.
Implement a coverage guardrail: when fewer than 3 substantive sessions are found in 24h, automatically expand analysis window to 72h (labeled) before generating improvement claims.
Ensure the daily audit has at least one additional non-self session in scope; if none exist, emit a structured 'no-data' audit status and skip improvement claims.
Expand audit coverage by persisting and sampling a broader set of sessions (>=7d rolling) before generating daily conclusions.
Add a hard coverage gate for daily audits: require >=3 non-self sessions in 24h or auto-expand to 72h/7d before producing improvement claims.
Ensure daily audit can enumerate all non-current sessions from the last 24h, or explicitly flag audit coverage as incomplete when session visibility is limited.
Add a hard audit coverage gate: require at least 3 non-self sessions from the last 24h or automatically expand the lookback / mark the audit as no-data before generating conclusions.
Add a hard audit fallback: if sessions_list coverage is sparse, pivot immediately to local transcript discovery and explicitly downgrade confidence instead of emitting NO_REPLY or thin conclusions.

Add hard completion gates plus a standard fallback path when sessions_list/web search surfaces are incomplete, so audits and monitors recover via transcript/RSS inspection instead of stalling or replying prematurely.

Add a hard no-data gate for daily audits: if sessions_list exposes only the current cron/self session in the 24h window, skip improvement claims, log coverage failure explicitly, and trigger a broader retrieval path outside the digest flow.

Add a hard completion gate plus degraded-mode fallback for cron audits/monitors: never emit NO_REPLY or stop after partial retrieval unless the required checks ran, source coverage is explicit, and a final contract-compliant answer is produced.

Add a shared cron completion contract: before any audit/monitor can emit NO_REPLY or final output, verify required checks ran, source/session coverage is explicit, degraded-mode fallback was attempted when needed, and delivery/output shape matches the task.
Add a preflight gate in this cron: if sessions_list returns <=1 session, broaden retrieval (kinds filter + higher limit + fallback transcript scan) before scoring.

Add a preflight step in this cron to enumerate sessions via sessions_list and abort early with a clear degraded-mode note when only self-session data is visible, then expand scope using explicit kind/channel filters or elevated visibility settings.
Add a preflight model-availability check with automatic fallback model routing for cron jobs before audit execution.
Broaden audit coverage by enumerating and sampling all non-cron sessions explicitly (main, discord, whatsapp, subagents) with a minimum-history quota before scoring.
Add a minimum-session threshold guard: if fewer than 3 non-system sessions exist in the last 24h, auto-mark audit as low-signal and skip user digest.
